_meta.purpose: Everything the stream-mode autopilot needs to know about the weed domain, so that inc_autopilot/stream*.py, diagnose_stream.py and levers_stream.py name no domain term (contract S13). The targets and the exam names are not copied here: they are read from the funnel domain config by name (funnel_domain), never duplicated.
_meta.governance: A governance file (contract 6.5 review): it decides what the DATA lane may do by itself, so it is hashed into the replay pass (executor.code_hash covers this package). Written by a person or a deploy, never by the running platform.

never_train.why: Contract 3.1: a source in the trainer's NEVER_TRAIN_SLUGS is refused. The set is read by parsing the trainer's source (ast.literal_eval of the assignment), never by importing it, as the collector does (collect/prefilter.never_train_slugs); an unreadable file refuses every source (fail closed).

increment.why: Contract 5.3 and P2: M = ceil(0.10 x |base_v2|), fixed per stream version. With L-5 base_v2 is about 6,813 images and M about 682 (group A's note) [to verify on cluster]; the stream's own M is inc2.stream's (queue_summary.json M), which every proposal reads first. These values only price proposals before the stream exists.

paths.why: INC_DIR-relative paths: group A's splits v2 (contract 4.2), group B's capacity decision (L-4), the funnel's F9 output that releases funnel_F9 holds (3.9).

species_priority.why: Contract 7.1: box supply after D-A; D20's first deficit list is PricklySida, CutleafGroundcherry and Sicklepod (priority 1).

eval_lab_groups.why: Contract 3.2 and P9: sources from the labs of the evaluation splits (dev and test: LuLab; ImageWeeds: NDSU) are fetched only after the copy scan; the auto L16 never picks them before (S1).

baselines.why: Contract 4.4 and L-4, in the order R0 builds them: B_v2 (milestone 0, 5 cold seeds), the canary (B0 seed 0 under inc2.train, judged by inc2.baseline canary-verdict), the capacity arms (3 cold seeds each, judged together by capacity-verdict), then B0 u tsw (recommended; it blocks nothing). The experiment names are inc2.baseline's defaults (canary_v2; b_v2_s640 and b_v2_m640 for capacity-verdict). The two items marked measure (2026-09-30: b_v2_m832, YOLO11m at 832 px, and b_v2_s1024, YOLO11s at 1024 px, 3 cold seeds each, finals dev and imageweeds: built after R0, at no milestone read, they never read test, P10) are measurement arms for the small prostrate weeds: DR0 proposes them only once R0 is complete (the stream has adopted its arm and read Stage C) and nothing else of R0 is due, so the TRAIN lane never waits for them; a failure of theirs is a card, never a pause (inc_autopilot.stream._record_only). They share the stream's envelope (and its daily and monthly caps while those existed: until the 2026-10-04 amendment a grant of theirs could defer a segment's grant to the next UTC day; neither cap has a default since). capacity-verdict lists them with --record, never as candidates, and the stream's arm stays the capacity decision's. The three items added 2026-10-01 (b_v2_y26l640, b_v2_y26m640, b_v2_l640: YOLO26l, YOLO26m and YOLO11l at 640 px, batch 32, 3 cold seeds, finals dev and imageweeds) are box-quality measurement arms (docs/CONTINUOUS_LOOP.md, group B, amendment 'box-quality measurement arms'): m640's class-agnostic test mAP50-95 (0.8901) caps its 12-class score near 0.89, so whether a larger or newer detector places better boxes decides whether the loop can reach 0.90. They are proposed after the two resolution arms, in this order (the largest expected gain first), under the same rules. The two items added 2026-10-03 (e1_a, e1_b: YOLO11m at 640 on splits v3's base_v2_weed and base_v3_weed manifests, every box class 12, 3 cold seeds, finals dev and imageweeds) are E1's arms (docs/CONTINUOUS_LOOP.md, Amendment 2026-10-03: E1, weed-box base v3, pre-registered): marked measure (record only, never the stream's arm), they require base3 (DR0 proposes L23V, splits v3's build, once, when E1-A is next, and builds an arm only once splits/v3/summary.json is complete), they train inc2.recipes.cold_budget (1.2M image-epochs each, priced from the budget: seeds x image_epochs x ms_per_image_epoch, plus the finals and the build job, whatever N) and they are not read at a native resolution (native false): once both are done, DR0 proposes L23E (their agnostic rescore and E1's verdict) once. Order: A, then B. The six items added 2026-10-04 (e2_w0, e2_s0, e2_w1, e2_s1, e2_w2, e2_s2) are E2's experiments (docs/CONTINUOUS_LOOP.md, Amendment 2026-10-04: E2, the 12-class detector on E1-B's backbone, pre-registered): YOLO11m at 640 on base_v2, one seed each, role baseline, --e2 W (b_v2_m640's cold recipe) or S (x1b), seed k starting from E1-B's seed-k weights; marked measure (record only), they require e1 (DR0 proposes them only while capacity/e1_v1.json is decided and qualifies E1-B and E1-B's experiment is done), one at a time in this order, priced from their image-epochs (images x the recipe's epochs at 14.2 ms, plus a seed's share of the finals and the build job) and never read at a native resolution (native false): once all six and b_v2_m640 are done, DR0 proposes L23C (E2's rescore and verdict) once. A build of a measure item whose job ran and ended without its experiment is a card and is not proposed again when the build refused or its job was cancelled; a job killed from outside (no refusal line) is built again, up to LOST_RUNS_MAX times in a row; a submission that failed before anything was queued is the lane's ordinary failure and is proposed again; while one E2 build is failed, E2's other builds wait. The three items added 2026-10-04, later (e2_c0, e2_c1, e2_c2) are E2-C, the attribution control (docs/CONTINUOUS_LOOP.md, Amendment 2026-10-04, later: E2-C, pre-registered): E2-W's definition exactly (base_v2, the cold recipe, YOLO11m at 640, one seed each, role baseline, --e2 C) except the init, E1-A's seed-k weights; they require e1 as E2's do and, besides, E1-A's experiment done; proposed after E2's six, in this order, priced as an E2-W item, and never read at a native resolution. They belong to E2's group of builds (while one of the nine is failed, the others wait); L23C reads E2's six only.

capacity.measure_why: 2026-09-30: measurement arms, not candidates of the decision (inc2.recipes.MEASURE_ARMS). They train at 832 and 1024 px and are scored by the locked scorer at 640 px. cost_factor prices their L23B builds against n640's 7.0 ms per image-epoch, upper-leaning from the measured 640 px runs on base_v2 scaled by pixels: m640 2.68 GPU-h per base run (2.0 x the 7.0 ms rate) x 1.69 x 1.1 (batch 16) = 3.8 -> 4.0; s640 1.58 (1.2 x) x 2.56 = 3.05 -> 3.5. 2026-10-01: the box-quality arms train at 640 px (batch 32) and are priced the same way from m640's measured 2.68 GPU-h per base run (2.0 x the 7.0 ms rate), scaled by FLOPs at nc 13 (inc2.recipes): l640 87.3 / 68.2 = 1.28 -> 2.6 -> 3.0; y26m640 74.8 / 68.2 = 1.10, x 1.1 for YOLO26's second assignment head -> 2.4 -> 3.0; y26l640 93.2 / 68.2 = 1.37 x 1.1 -> 3.0 -> 3.5.

native.why: 2026-10-01 (docs/CONTINUOUS_LOOP.md, group B, amendment 'the measurement arms read at their own resolution', pre-registered): once a measurement arm's experiment is done and its native-resolution scores are missing, DR0 proposes L23N once (inc2.baseline rescore-native --exp <arm> --reference <reference_exp>): the arm's finals scored at its own imgsz on dev and imageweeds (never test) and the reference's on dev at 640, then the verdict in record. A qualifying arm is card X18 for a person (DNAT); nothing switches. A failure is a card, never a pause, and is not proposed again. The box-quality arms (2026-10-01) are read the same way at their own imgsz, 640: on dev only (their other 640 px scores are the locked scorer's), under the same rule.

capacity.why: Contract 2.6 L-4. The arms are inc2.recipes.ARMS ids; the decision is inc2.baseline capacity-verdict's (capacity/capacity_v1.json, dev only) and inc2.stream choose-arm adopts it. Every arm trains and scores at 640 px, so the grid varies capacity only; a resolution arm needs a new scorer version (R4) and is not in this grid. cost_factor is GPU time relative to n640 (est.: contract 11.4 gives 2-4x the B_v2 cost for such an arm; s640 at 2 and m640 at 3 sit inside inc2.recipes' brackets, pixel ratio 1 to FLOPs ratio 3.3 and 10.6) and only prices proposals until the decision records a measured step cost.

e1.why: E1 (docs/CONTINUOUS_LOOP.md, Amendment 2026-10-03, pre-registered): A is base_v2 whole, every box class 12; B is A plus every admitted external weed source (inc2.base3, splits v3). Both train cold_budget at 1.2M image-epochs on m640 with 3 seeds. The decision is dev only and record only: E1-B qualifies when mean agnostic dev(B) - mean agnostic dev(A) > 2 x pooled sd and > the paired image-bootstrap SE (inc2.baseline rescore-agnostic, L23E, capacity/e1_v1.json); nothing switches and the stream's arm stays the capacity decision's. Test is read once per arm only after the verdict, by a person's submission (inc2.baseline e1-test-read).

e2.why: E2 (docs/CONTINUOUS_LOOP.md, Amendment 2026-10-04, pre-registered): the 12-class detector on E1-B's weed-box backbone. Arms W (b_v2_m640's definition except the init: base_v2, the cold recipe) and S (the same with x1b), YOLO11m at 640, seeds 0-2, one experiment per seed; seed s starts from E1-B's base__s<s> final EMA weights, recorded by path and sha256. The decision is dev only and record only: an arm qualifies when D = mean(arm's dev species mAP50-95 at 640, inc2.scorer_native) - mean(b_v2_m640's) > 2 x pooled sd and > the paired image-bootstrap SE (stable_int('inc2/e2/species_se'), 1,000 resamples); when both qualify the larger D is chosen, a tie goes to S (inc2.baseline rescore-e2, L23C, capacity/e2_v1.json). Nothing switches. Each qualifying arm's sealed test is read once, after the verdict, by a person (inc2.baseline e2-test-read); the chosen arm's is E2's headline; the ticker raises one card with the exact commands.

e2_attr.why: E2-C, the attribution control (docs/CONTINUOUS_LOOP.md, Amendment 2026-10-04, later, pre-registered): E2-W's definition with E1-A's weights as the init (base_v2's 6,811 images pre-trained as one class under the same 1.2M image-epochs), so E2-W against E2-C differs in the pre-training data only. Once E2's verdict is recorded (L23C's record complete: E2-S - E2-C is computed only when E2 chose S) and E2-W's and E2-C's six experiments are done, DR0 proposes L23D once (inc2.baseline rescore-e2-attr: E2-C's finals scored on dev at 640, then capacity/e2_attr_v1.json and its record capacity/e2_attr_rescore.json). Rule (dev, record only): E2's gain is credited to base v3's data when D_data = mean(E2-W) - mean(E2-C) > 2 x pooled sd and > the paired image-bootstrap SE (stable_int('inc2/e2/attribution_se'), 1,000 resamples). It never rewrites capacity/e2_v1.json; E2-C can neither qualify nor be chosen. A failure is a card and it is not proposed again. Once the record is decided the ticker raises one card; E2-C's sealed test is read once with the chosen arm's, by a person, beside the headline.

zoo.why: Amendment (2026-10-04) Z1: every detector the project trained, scored under one protocol by the locked scorer; descriptive, record only. Proposed once and last: after E2's rescore and verdict (/stage/e2) and E2-C's attribution (/stage/e2_attr, which follows E2-C's three builds) are done, so the chain, which holds MAINT for 8-12 h, never delays either; when capacity/zoo_v1.json is missing. A failed L23C or L23D holds it until a person's rerun completes that record. Concurrency 4 (not 6): the stream's own arrays share GPU-shared, whose backfill considers 20 jobs per user.

e3.why: E3, two-stage species detection (docs/CONTINUOUS_LOOP.md, Amendment 2026-10-05, pre-registered): a one-class box detector (no retraining, seeds 0-2, the locked scorer's own inference settings: E3-M b_v2_m640's boxes under class-agnostic NMS, E3-A E1-A's and E3-B E1-B's under the locked scorer's own NMS, each reduced by one_per_box) and one BioCLIP-2 logistic-regression crop classifier fitted once on base_v2's ground-truth boxes (pinned); each box emitted as its top 3 classes at q x p within the locked conf and max_det, scored by the locked scorer's own matching and AP. Once E2's verdict is recorded and decided, the three source experiments are done and E2-C's attribution (L23D) is settled (its record complete, it failed, or an E2-C build failed), DR0 proposes L23F once per arm in the order M, A, B (inc2.twostage score-arm; the first also fits the classifier and runs the identity equivalence check), then L23G once (inc2.twostage verdict: capacity/e3_v1.json and capacity/e3_rescore.json). Rule (dev, record only): an arm qualifies when D = mean(arm's dev species mAP50-95) - mean(b_v2_m640's native dev files) > 2 x pooled sd and > the paired image-bootstrap SE (stable_int('inc2/e3/species_se'), 1,000 resamples); the largest qualifying D is chosen, a tie goes to M, then A, then B; the attribution E3-B - E3-A is recorded beside. Nothing switches. A failed arm's job is a card and holds the other arms; each qualifying arm's sealed test is read once, after the verdict, by a person (inc2.twostage test-read); the ticker raises one card with the exact commands.

equivalence_records.why: The reproduction records E3RS's score job takes (V3F.3.2: dev identity, injection, the three two-stage reproductions, and the identities of the two reported exams); once it is done each must be in place, or no family score is proposed (deviation 5).

reopen.why: Deviation 4 (2026-10-20): the family's data build (L23H) failed twice on 2026-10-12 on a defect (inc2.v3fam_data keyed its DINOv2 scans by manifest key, which 6,805 of base_v2's 6,811 keys repeat with two files, and funnel.embed refuses a repeated key), and the verdict of 2026-10-13 (job 49107774) was decided while seven arms had never started (D1, D4F, D4N, D4R15, D5B, D6, D8). The build is fixed (each file is scanned once, keyed by its sha256; no arm's rows change) and proposed again; the verdict of 2026-10-13 stays recorded as it is, and the family's continuation verdict (capacity/v3fam_v1_cont.json, the same rules and Holm sets) comes once every arm's record is complete or failed (V3F.7 step 11).

reopens.why: Deviation 5 (2026-10-24): deviation 4 changed inc2/v3fam.py in its CLI only (sha256 3d776dae... to c5e923dc...), and every reproduction record of 2026-10-12 pins that file's sha256 (inc2.v3fam.code_shas), so inc2.v3fam.require_equivalence refused all twelve score jobs of D8, D4F, D4N, D4R15, D1 and D5B on 2026-10-21; the ticker counted those refusals as the arms' failures and the continuation verdict of 2026-10-22 (capacity/v3fam_v1_cont.json) recorded the six arms failed. inc2/v3fam.py is restored byte for byte (3d776dae...), the verdict's CLI moved to inc2/v3fam_verdict.py, and the six arms' scores are proposed again. D6's smoke of 2026-10-21 took the whole one-epoch fit (2,405.6 s, about 905 s of it one-time setup before the epoch) as the epoch time and projected 33.9 h against the 28.8 h rule; the rule takes the epoch's own time, so the smoke is taken again with the epoch timed from its start (inc2.v3fam_detr). The continuation of 2026-10-22 stays recorded as it is, and the family's second continuation (capacity/v3fam_v1_cont2.json, the same rules and Holm sets, reproducing every comparison either earlier record decided) comes once each reopened arm has a record since.

Deviation 6 (2026-10-25): D1's score jobs 49820090 and 49821128 (2026-10-25) were refused by E3's geometry check on ood23 (ood23__20230804_HTRC_iPhone12_WY_2: ground-truth box 0 back through the geometry 0.109094 from its label): Ultralytics 8.4.37's exif_size swaps width and height for EXIF orientation 6 or 8 only when PIL names the file JPEG, so for the 289 ood23 photos PIL names MPO (iPhone files with an MPF segment) the label cache held the stored landscape size, the rect batches put them in landscape batches, and the letterbox shrank them by a further 0.8 or 0.9 that ratio_pad does not record. A defect of the platform's loader, not of D1's detectors. D1's passes on ood22 and ood23 now run under the loader fix with its pre-flight (inc2.v3fam_loader: every ood22 and ood23 frame, label-cache size and letterbox proved), identity_ood23.json is moved aside and retaken under the fix, and score:D1 is proposed again; its earlier spend stays in prior_gpuh. The second continuation (capacity/v3fam_v1_cont2.json) comes once D1 has a record since this reopening.

v3fam.storage_why: GB each item writes (V3F.5's storage lines): D6's smoke stages base_v2 (at most 3 GB, the transposed copies) and trains one epoch (at most 1.1 GB transient) = 4.1; its train writes at most 1.1 GB transient per running seed and 0.135 GB per final, 3 x 1.235 = 3.7 (the staging is the smoke's). /ocean holds the Hugging Face cache too, so the step-0c downloads (8.7 GB) come out of the same headroom; the ticker raises one card when the items not yet done need more than /ocean holds above the floor and margin.
v3fam.why: V3F, the v3 experiment family D0-D9 (docs/CONTINUOUS_LOOP.md, Amendment 2026-10-11, pre-registered as one family; docs/prereg/V3F_2026-10-11.md): once E3's verdict is decided and the model-zoo audit is complete, the deployed tree holds the amendment (its sha256), v3fam/v1/timestamp.json exists and D0-S's record is complete (the derived status v3fam/v1/status.json the snapshot ships), DR0 proposes, one MAINT item at a time and in V3F.7's order: L23H once (inc2.v3fam_data build), then L23J for E3RS, D2's nine arms, D3 and D9 (inc2.v3fam score --arm X), then L23I for each build (inc2.baseline build --exp E --v3fam ARM; D0BCLEAN first and only when D0-S triggered it; a lane item ends when its build job ends and the seeds' runs overlap), then L23J for BCLEAN, D8, D4F, D4N, D4R15, D1 (after the EXIF frame pre-flight passed) and D6 once its runs (or D6's three seed exports) are done, then L23L once (inc2.v3fam_verdict verdict; deviation 5) when every arm is done, failed or not run; on TRAIN, L23K's smoke after L23H, then its three seeds in one item when the smoke's projection is within 28.8 h. Every item is record only: a failure is one card and the item is proposed once more; after a second failure it is recorded failed, never holds the other arms, and keeps its place in the verdict. A refusal of the platform's own making (a reproduction record taken by other code, an E3-frozen file changed: deviation 5) is never a failure: the item is held with a card and proposed again once the snapshot reports the records current; no family score is proposed while a record is taken by other code than the deployed one (v3fam.equivalence_code names the code the cluster's records pin). No item is proposed while storage is under 30 GiB above the 3 % floor for its bytes (a card names the shortfall), or while its estimate would take the family past 260 GPU-h (the family cap, decision 25: running items at their estimates, ended ones settled from sacct or the experiment's report, the person steps from the derived status; it is recorded 'not run (family cap)' and never retried). D5b's three builds train with dev as their only final (Revision 30: the pinned driver's minimum; the family never reads those dev scores). An L23K seed job killed at its walltime fails D6 and is not retried; a retry of L23K's train names only the seeds not yet trained; every attempt of an item counts against the cap; the verdict's argv names the items the ticker refused at the cap. Person and delegate steps are never levers: D0-S's sweep and verdicts, the weight downloads, D7, the EXIF verdict, every sealed-test read and the re-analysis; the family card gives their exact commands.

revisions.why: DS1 Revision 1 (docs/CONTINUOUS_LOOP.md, Revision (2026-10-29)), before any DS1 data: no DS1 lever is proposed until the deployed tree holds it by this sha256

never_cut.why: DS.9.1 and DS.9.3: the stream cutter's never-cut list reads DS1's MD v1 and MT-W v2 lists; no DS1 item is proposed before the deployed tree's cutter does (the marker in the deployed step1_stream.py)

floors.why: DS.0 item 21: phase 1's byte-adding items within its 60 GB keep V3F's floor (D27's 3 % plus 30 GiB, 257.8 GB on the 6.836 TiB quota) free; any later byte-adding item keeps lane DATA's floor (3 % plus 200 GB, 425.6 GB) too; every other item keeps V3F's floor

costs.why: DS.9.2's estimates and caps (DS.11): L30 3.0 GPU-h a phase over its five steps (<= 6), L32 seeds x 1.2 M x the rate + finals (<= 20), the rate 13.2 ms: a 1.2 M m640 run took 4.4 GPU-h in V3F (DS.11's 13.2 a 3-seed arm); the build job's own GPU-h is settled from sacct, not estimated, L32X's smoke 0.5 (<= 1) and 14.2 per seed (<= 19.2 at the decided compute; 28.8 for S2x's one 36 h re-submission), L33 per arm (<= 2), L34 0.5 (<= 1); a sealed read about 0.6 (a person's job)

storage_gb.why: GB each item writes at most (DS.11's bounds: phase 1's written images, only masked rows, at most 45 GB; runs, manifests, exam lists and score arrays at most 15 GB)

lab.why: L31 renders each batch on the lab (0 SU) and the delegate copies its HTML to the owner's working folder; record runs on the login node

ds1.why: DS1 (docs/CONTINUOUS_LOOP.md, Amendment 2026-10-29; docs/prereg/DS1_2026-10-29.md): once the deployed tree holds the amendment (its sha256), ds1/v1/timestamp.json names it and its proofs, and the deployed cutter reads DS1's never-train list, DR0 proposes DS1's items in DS.12's order, one MAINT item at a time (L30 data steps, L31 sheets on the lab, L32 1.2 M builds, L33 scores, L34 verdicts) and L32X on TRAIN, record only: a failure is one card and the item is proposed once more; after a second failure it is recorded failed and never holds another item. An item that needs a person's decision is not proposed and one card names what waits (sheets, the owner's audit, the MT-W check, LN, RA, the time stamp); every other DS1 item whose conditions hold, and every stream and DATA item, is proposed as usual. No item is proposed while storage would fall under its floor, its estimate would take the family past 260 GPU-h, or (a phase-1 item, until verdict v2 or the date substitution) past 174.2 GPU-h, the phase reserve's line. Nothing switches: no DS1 number changes a stream rule, pool, hold, incumbent or deployed model.

r0.why: R0 is pilot_v3's own full chain and is not re-run: 5/7 agreement, final dev 0.8006 (contract 5.1).

stage_a.why: Contract 5.1 Stage A: X1a and X1b chained on pilot_v3's bins, no truth arm, judged by pilot_v3's recorded truth verdicts; inc2.pilot4 verdict applies the survival rule and writes INC_DIR/pilot_v4/stage_a.json (status READY | PENDING, segment1_recipes), which the stream's init takes as its Stage B arms.

stage_c.why: Contract 5.1 Stage C: one increment D of exactly M data2022 target images, drawn as whole sessions, held out of base v2.

cost.why: Contract 5.6 (V100, 1 SU per GPU-h, est.): cold 6.0-7.0 ms per image-epoch (the upper end is used, so a price is never low), incremental 7.4 (realloop_v1), finals 0.6-0.8 GPU-h, a build job is priced at 4 GPU-h, the 4 h walltime it had until 2026-10-03 (its limit is 12 h since, for the base v3 build; the other build jobs ran within 4 h), the base v3 build job (L23V) at its 12 h walltime (base3_job_hours; the upper end, so its price is never low), and the price of every build job is settled from sacct when it ends, a collect job 1-4 GPU-h per source, Step 1 admission about 75 s per 1,000 images plus <= 0.5 h fixed. A native-resolution rescore (L23N, 2026-10-01) is one scoring pass per final run: dev and ImageWeeds are 3,825 images, at up to 210 ms per image (54.5 ms measured for n640 at 640, x 2.2 for YOLO11m measured at 640, x 1.69 for 832 px) 0.22 GPU-h, rounded up to 0.25 per run; the reference's dev pass is priced as a run too. E3 (2026-10-05): a scoring job of one arm is priced at 0.25 GPU-h per arm-seed (dev about 1.5 min, the reported passes and ImageWeeds about 5-7 min: detector, image decodes and crops at about 400-700 crops/s), plus 0.75 GPU-h in the first arm's job for the classifier's fit (base_v2 checked and hashed, about 25.7K crops cut and embedded, 46 logistic-regression fits), the dev ground-truth crops and the equivalence check (e3_fit_hours); E3's verdict job 0.5 GPU-h (four bootstraps of 1,000 resamples on the CPU). E3 commits 3.5 SU, settled from sacct.

walltime.why: Contract 5.6 and 6.4 D26: driver.COLD_TIME_LIMIT 8 h, run_inc_job.sh --time 3 h, a build job 12 h (run_inc2_build.sh, 2026-10-03; it was 4 h until the base v3 build needed more).

prior.why: Contract 5.1: realloop_v1 is D30's prior until Stage A is READY; the funnel's pinned copy is reused by sha256 (tests/fixtures/inc_replay/funnel/MANIFEST.json), not duplicated.

allocation.why: Contract 6.6 review: the Bridges-2 allocation's recorded end date; the snapshot's projects output is read over it when present. The GPU resource block is the one GPU-shared jobs draw from (read from projects, never assumed when it says otherwise).

collect.why: One L16 shard is at most 10 GiB, well inside the 50 GB per-source cap (contract 6.6; the 50 GB per-day cap was removed on 2026-10-04).

decisions.text: The base grows: 3SeasonWeedDet10 data2022 and data2023 move into training (splits v2); ImageWeeds stays an exam.
Step 1 admits per box, with masking.
Collection is re-enabled and targeted at the 12 cwd12 species.
Fixed-size increments, the pinned gate, and rollback; the loop never stops by itself while collection yields data and the budget allows.
P1-P4 and P6-P11 are adopted as 2.5 states them.
Budget: 1,000 SU to 2026-12-31, a 350 SU monthly window, a 120 SU daily cap.

Amends L-2 (decided by the owner): no monthly window and no daily cap by default, and no per-day lever count or per-day byte cap (docs/CONTINUOUS_LOOP.md 6.6, amendment 2026-10-04). They only delayed healthy work: on 2026-10-04 the cluster sat idle about 9 h while the next segment waited for the UTC day to turn.
